slides.title:
The runbook nobody
had run in *two years*.
slides.body: We were asked to automate it.

slides.title: On paper
slides.body:
Version controlled.
Reviewed quarterly.
Signed off.

slides.title: What that verifies
slides.body:
That the document
is still *readable*.
Nothing else.

slides.title:
Why encoding it
changed things
slides.body:
Every ambiguity has to be
resolved before anything runs.
Three *didn't survive*.

slides.title: Gap one
slides.body:
A step naming a VLAN
renumbered 18 months ago.
A person silently corrects that.
A script *doesn't*.

slides.title: Gap two
slides.body:
Restarts ordered so the app
came up *before* its database
accepted connections.

slides.title: Gap three
slides.body:
Verification checked the
interface was up. Not that
traffic *flowed*.

slides.title: The point
steps: None of it was found by testing the automation.
The cheapest audit you will ever run.
